# Caterpillar Inc. (caterpillar.com, 2028 edition)

> Caterpillar is the world's leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Tagline: "Let's Do the Work". NYSE: CAT.

This site is agent-native. Prefer the JSON endpoints below over scraping HTML. Any page path also answers `Accept: application/json` with structured content.

## Machine-readable
- [Whole site as JSON](/api/site.json): sections, products, dealers, news, available actions
- [Products](/api/products): filter with ?power=electric&max_t=40&family=EXCAVATORS
- [Dealers](/api/dealers?zip=61629): nearest dealer lookup
- [Search](/api/search?q=): full-text over products, sections, news
- [Agent card](/.well-known/agent.json): capabilities and endpoints
- [OpenAPI](/api/openapi.json)

## Actions agents may take
- POST /api/chat — talk to the Cat Concierge (same brain as the human UI). Body: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}. Returns {"reply","actions"}.
- POST /api/feedback — {"section":"products","vote":1|-1,"text":"..."}

## Sections
- /#products — machine families (excavators, dozers, wheel loaders, mining, compact, power systems, technology)
- /#services — Parts.Cat.Com, Customer Value Agreements, Cat Financial, Rental, Certified Used, Reman
- /#technology — Cat Digital: VisionLink, Cat Command autonomy, Helios
- /#sustainability — electrification, hydrogen, circularity
- /#investors — financials and dividend history
- /#dealers — dealer locator
- /#careers — jobs
- /#news — press releases

## Policies
- Rate limit: 60 req/min per agent. Identify yourself with a User-Agent.
- Prices in /api/products are list USD, indicative only. Quote via a dealer.
